story_so_far: Chapter 9 opens on the floor-17 goblin army (mission: 'DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN WARRIORS'). Juhyeok, flanked by Gobang and a caped figure in dark gear, commands 'WIPE THEM ALL OUT.' Gobang ignites into a golden flame pillar, roars 'GRARRR!', and blast-wipes the army — goblins fly, spears rain, Gobang lands crouched and glowing. Juhyeok watches, amazed ('WOW... THAT PERFORMANCE IS INSANE') and delivers his rental-bikes-vs-K2-tank analogy while a literal tank fires on-panel. Floor 17 clears: system notices award S++ and a Platinum Badge. A pale-haired witness screams 'BOM SANSA...?!' at the result. After the title card, floor 18 begins: 'DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN ASSASSINS' — monsters that use stealth skills. The trio advances ('MOVE OUT.') but the cloaked, red-masked assassins phase through cyan smoke and ambush: one clings to Gobang invisible (blue dashed outline), another leaves a fish on his head; Juhyeok panics ('THIS MIGHT NOT BE AS EASY AS I THOUGHT?'). Gobang pounds the ground channeling golden energy ('COME OUT! ASSASSINS ARE ALL COWARDS!'). A booming 'MUHAHAHAHA' answers over a dark tree canopy: a lean auburn-haired man in dark sleeveless assassin gear appears, mocks Juhyeok ('YOU'VE SUFFERED WATCHING THAT IGNORANT BASTARD GOBANG'S STRATEGY UNTIL NOW'), vows to 'PURIFY YOUR EYES WITH A CLASSY WALKTHROUGH!', boasts 'THOSE GOBLINS' STEALTH IS NOTHING COMPARED TO MINE', flashes the skill SHADOW STEP, and massacres the goblin assassins in a golden spotlight void as the kill counter races toward 30.

last_beat.description: Golden-void massacre panel (59800-62500): the dark-gear assassin's blue afterimages shred the goblin assassins into particle showers under spotlight beams; a blue system box tracks '[COMPLETE CONDITION: GOBLIN ASSASSIN .../30]' with the counter racing (6,7,8,9). Panel art ends ~62500; only a purple SFX '챠챠' spill on white continues past y=62700 (to ~62900) — covered as excluded spacing, not a beat continuation.
